_comment: Copilot-native base settings. Profiles override these in their own .copilot/settings.overrides.json. Never declare a `hooks` key here: copilot merges inline settings hooks with the hooks/ directory, so declaring both fires every hook twice. Hooks are adapter-written to ~/.copilot/hooks/agentihooks.json.

_agentihooks._comment: Reserved directive block: consumed by the installer, never written to settings.json (copilot warns about unknown top-level keys). Carries what copilot has no settings key for.
_agentihooks._comment_channels: Claude carries the broadcast subscription list in its settings `env` block; copilot has no `env` settings key, so without this the session reads an unset AGENTIHOOKS_BASE_CHANNELS, subscribes to nothing, and every channel-targeted broadcast passes it by. Matches the claude default in profiles/default/.claude/settings.overrides.json.
